items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Phineas Newborn, of the young pianists, to me is the greatest, of the young pianists.

ctx.x: The piano, being a pluckless instrument where you just strike it, it takes quite some doing to --
Oscar Peterson to me is another pianist that -- oh, I can name you pianists that -- and Phineas Newborn.
